k5start_start.description: Whether to start k5start. Set to 'yes' to force starting, any other value disables it.

k5start_keytab.description: Path to the Kerberos keytab file for k5start.

k5start_ccrefresh.description: Interval in seconds for k5start to refresh the ticket cache.

k5start_principal.description: Kerberos principal for k5start. Supports shell expansion like $(hostname -f).
